entries.profile_scope: 1.8B experimental v7 batch with same-scene source context
entries.expected_invariant: A source-only context cue must not supply a monetary fact to a target without a recognized amount; reject such output before checkpoint and preserve its raw response.
entries.last_outcome: The repeated real model still copied the money context, but the revised v7 validator rejected it before any checkpoint; nonmonetary contamination and complete batching remain open.
